envelope.text: the server, keyed by goal id, result by const reference: there is no goal

why:
terminates a goal as succeeded with its result -- rclcpp_action's `ServerGoalHandle::succeed(shared_ptr<Result>)`. Same capability, two shape differences: it is a method on the SERVER keyed by goal id rather than on an owning handle (see `cpp:Server::publish_feedback` for why), and it takes the result by const reference rather than by `shared_ptr`. A thin forwarder over `cpp:Server::complete_goal`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
